title: Arrays
explanation: An array holds a fixed number of values of one type. Write it out with braces, then reach into it with square brackets.
Positions start at 0, so a 5-item array has indexes 0 to 4 and palette.length is 5. Asking for palette[5] is an error.
There are two ways to walk an array: a counting for loop when you need the index, or a for-each loop when you only care about each value.
